notes: Abstract-only publication (page 2: 'This is an abstract-only publication. The complete research paper ... is available upon request.'). The intervention is 'Sustainable rice cultivation techniques (SRCTs)', never defined; nothing shows it is SRI as the vocabulary defines it (components not stated), so the first failing criterion is no_defined_practice. It would also fail no_outcome_data: the abstract says financial returns were collected but reports only a 20% yield increase and 15% water-use reduction, no cost/return, adoption or carbon value. Credibility concern: published in 'African Fisheries Science (Fisheries/Aquatic)' with a 2013 date but a Zenodo DOI; full text would need to be requested.
